acceptance: A dead or missing detached runner with a non-terminal child task is deterministically identified from bounded registry, liveness, and task-record evidence.

The launcher records or appends one idempotent, source-labelled recovery-candidate observation containing job identity, observation time, dead-process reason, record status, worktree/preservation reference, and applicable retry context.

Repeated observation does not create duplicate recovery attempts or alter child task authority; --jobs presents reconciliation state and reason, and terminal/completed jobs are not falsely reconciled.

Provider-free focused fixtures cover dead/non-terminal, dead/terminal, completion-line-present, missing/unreadable record, preserved-worktree, and repeated-observation cases while affected launcher/process tests remain passing.
No automatic restart, task-status mutation, budget reallocation, subtree cancellation, provider call, host/setup change, package-host distribution, or broad registry redesign is included.
